text:
maya: quick signal — new qbringup (quant3b-int8) shows a quality spike for longform RAG summaries. EM delta ~6% vs baseline on our longctx golden. need curation + fast relabel.

jon: can you drop a few repros? is it hallucination or omission?

maya: mostly hallucination (fabrication). examples are all >3k token contexts. tiny repro: 
```
{id: g-9001, prompt: 'Summarize interview', baseline: 'mentions the CTO resigned', q3b: 'claims CTO founded the company in 2018'}
```

li: that smells like kv-cache alignment + quant rounding. shortctx routes look fine.

sara: I can create a micro-golden of 150 prioritized by EM delta + halluc flag. who can label? alice and rachel available tomorrow AM.

alice: ok for me. please include explicit instruction to mark exact hallucinated spans and label type.

rachel: add a boolean for "affects factual claim" vs "creative inference". helps triage fixes.

jon: engineering triage plan: 1) reproduce with prefix-cache disabled, 2) dump kv-cache and logits for 20 ids, 3) run kernel fallbacks.

maya: sampling query pushed: `samplebank query --model q3b --route rag-long --delta>0.04 --limit 500 > /tmp/q3b_hallux.json`

deploy-bot: canary checker: q3b-int8-v1 -> rolled back at 2024-05-14T09:12Z for route rag-long due to 5.2% quality regression.

li: i'll run `kv-diff --ids g-9001,g-9012 --base baseline --new q3b` and attach traces.

sara: labeling instructions draft uploaded: https://labelflow/tasks/5022 — includes 4 examples (2 fabrication, 2 misinference) and the schema: [hallucination, type, span, note].

alice: reviewed. small tweak: clarify that partial overlap with ground truth counts as "incorrect_infer" not "fabrication".

sara: updated. assigning alice + rachel now.

jon: once relabel done, run eval harness on full golden to estimate customer impact. if confirmed, options: 1) revert quant kernel for attention, 2) alter quant scale params, 3) apply targeted prompt-safety guard for route.

maya: prioritize customer-facing routes. I'll notify support if we need to escalate.

rachel: labelers starting in 30m, will ping when micro-golden done.

maya: thanks — please include a few near-duplicates to check de-dup sensitivity in sampling.

jon: noted. will also run logit-diff script: `compare_logits.py --ids g-9001,g-9012 --models baseline,q3b --out /tmp/logit_diffs` to find token prob shifts.

maya: good. follow-up report expected after relabels and kv/logit artifacts attached.

sara: on it. :thumbsup:
